_comment: Phonetic respellings applied to quest text before synthesis, because a TTS model reads Warcraft proper nouns as English. Keys match whole words case-insensitively; apostrophes in keys are matched literally. Respellings are what the model should say, hyphenated by syllable. The apostrophe is the main offender: the model reads it as a possessive or a hard glottal stop. A hyphen and plain vowels fix both.
_policy: This file used to say an entry should only be added once the mispronunciation had been heard and the respelling checked against the game's own voice-over. That rule is still the right one for anything below _unverified. The entries under _unverified break it deliberately, because apostrophe names were audibly wrong across the board and waiting to hear all 60 individually was not practical. They are a consistent application of Warcraft conventions, not canon. Check them by ear and promote or correct as you go.
_sourcing: The list is the apostrophe proper nouns that actually occur in passages.json, site_batch.json and npcs.txt, ordered by frequency, rather than guessed at. English contractions were excluded; the model reads those correctly.
_verified_or_canon: Below have an established pronunciation in the games and can be checked against Blizzard's own voice-over.
_unverified: Below are Midnight-era names with no canon reading. Conventions applied, not heard. These are the ones to audit first.
